'''Momaw Nadon's house''' was a location in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] refugee [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] lived. The house contained many side domes, and held a large garden that contained a [[Mos Eisley bafforr grove|grove]] of [[bafforr tree]]s, a [[vesuvague tree]] and several other plants.<ref name="TFMEC">{{StoryCite|story=The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
